hero.title: What's happening at SSC
hero.body: Our campus is busiest when the wider community is in it. Craft fairs, art openings, and monthly activity calendars for both households — all in one place.
hero.imageAlt: Residents and neighbors gathered at a Sheboygan Senior Community event

featured.title: The Local Collective Craft Fair
paragraphs: Share your creativity with the community at The Local Collective Craft Fair hosted by Sheboygan Senior Community! We're looking for talented artisans, makers, crafters, and local small businesses to showcase their unique, handcrafted products while connecting with shoppers of all ages.
Whether you create home décor, jewelry, artwork, specialty foods, gifts, or other handmade goods, we'd love to have you join us for this exciting community event.
Ready to be a vendor? Complete the vendor application today and reserve your space before spots fill up. We can't wait to help you share your craft with the community!
featured.imageAlt: Handmade pottery, knitwear, artwork and jewelry displayed on vendor tables at a community craft fair
